What it does not do

  • Follows one person; for two, hold still and drag.

Is CapCut Auto Reframe free?

Not now. CapCut's help page says it was "moved to the CapCut Pro (premium) tier as part of ongoing product development". CapCut help, 3 April 2026

Two people in the shot?

It follows one of them; hold still, then drag the window to the other. Choppity, which takes an upload, says its tool "detects multiple speakers and creates split-screen layouts or switches focus to the active speaker automatically". Choppity, 19 Sep 2026

Is my clip uploaded?

No. It stays on your device, and there is no account. Our privacy page
